draft.text: You came in because you hurt your right knee while water skiing last weekend.
You have swelling and soreness, especially when you squat or bend your knee.
We did not do any tests or exams during this visit.
You may have injured your knee, but you have not had any locking, instability, or feeling like your knee gives way.
An X-ray was ordered to check for broken bones.
You will continue using cold packs and Aleve for pain.
You should avoid putting weight on your knee and rest it as much as possible.
You will follow up with your doctor once the X-ray results are available.
